plainTranslation: Their Sun in your 12th house can feel strangely familiar and hard to define. They may light up hidden fears, dreams, projections, or parts of you that operate under the surface. Bring the connection into daylight before you build a whole story in private.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Refined from approved project relationship source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
